home.title: Your last Minecraft launcher
home.lead: Download, update, and back up in one place so you can get straight to your next adventure. Open source and cross-platform.

sections.featuresTitle: Manage Minecraft content without the extra steps
sections.featuresLead: Find a mod, install a modpack, or jump back into a familiar world. Browse content from Modrinth and CurseForge in one place, and handle installs, dependencies, and updates right in the launcher.
sections.galleryLead: The home screen, themes and lab are all screenshots from the launcher itself.
sections.contributorsLead: Code, docs, translations and feedback all come from contributors in the public repository.
sections.freeOSBody: Axolotl is released under GPL-3.0, is free to use and ad-free, and is independent of Modrinth.
sections.contentManBody: Install and manage both modpacks and individual projects from Modrinth and CurseForge.
sections.gaugeBody: Efficient downloads and a lightweight desktop core keep the launcher responsive while it prepares game files and modpacks, so you can spend more time playing.
sections.dohBody: The launcher uses DNS over HTTPS (DoH) by default to resolve download domains for faster, smoother downloads.
sections.downloadTitle: Local mirrors for downloads in China
sections.downloadBody: If downloads are slow, you can choose mirrors in China for game assets and mods.
sections.dotmcTitle: Pick up where you left off
sections.dotmcBody: Add an existing .minecraft folder to manage its game versions in Axolotl. You can manage multiple game folders without copying their files again.
sections.flowTitle: Three steps back to the game.
sections.flowInstallBody: Grab the package for your platform; the first run checks the runtime.
sections.flowChooseBody: Create an isolated instance from a release, snapshot or modpack.
sections.flowLaunchBody: Dependencies, Java and your account are ready in one pass.
sections.capabilitiesTitle: Everything you need, nothing in the way.
sections.capAccountsBody: Microsoft sign-in and offline profiles coexist; switching never disturbs an instance.
sections.capJavaBody: The right runtime for each Minecraft version, with missing JDKs fetched automatically.
sections.capModsBody: Import a Modrinth modpack and resolve dependencies and updates in one pass.
sections.capOfflineBody: Launch a prepared instance even when the network is gone.
sections.capThemesBody: Light, dark and OLED surfaces that follow the system or switch by hand.
sections.capOpenBody: Code, release pipeline and docs live in public repositories: auditable and self-hostable.
sections.ctaTitle: Make the next launch a better one.
sections.ctaBody: Download Axolotl, or read the docs first and decide after.
